title: Aymo AI
claim: Product Hunt: Aymo AI — All-in-one AI Platform for Teams
why_good: An all-in-one AI platform for teams — broad and generic; 'all-in-one' pitches rarely win against focused tools.
value: Team subscription, but the value prop is diffuse; hard to say why a team switches from ChatGPT Team / Claude.
risk: Undifferentiated 'AI platform' — crowded, generic, and outgunned by the model vendors' own team products.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Aymo AI —— 面向团队的一体化 AI 平台。
zh.why_good: 一个面向团队的一体化 AI 平台——宽泛且通用;一体化的定位很难打过聚焦型工具。
zh.value: 团队订阅,但价值主张发散;很难说清团队为何要从 ChatGPT Team/Claude 迁过来。
zh.risk: 没差异的 AI 平台——拥挤、通用,被模型厂商自家的团队产品压制。
